text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update to the General Government Committee on Fleet Services' actions of reducing vehicle and equipment downtime and minimizing the number of underutilized vehicles as requested by City Council on October 17, 2019 (Item - 2019.GL8.1) , with the latest annual update provided on May 30, 2023 (Item - 2023.GG4.28) .
The General Government Committee: 1. Received the report (March 11, 2024) from the General Manager, Fleet Services, for information.
